raw_message.reasoning:
The TZ_PAT is `r'(\s+[-+]\d\d?:?\d\d)'`. This pattern matches:
- `\s+` - whitespace
- `[-+]` - sign
- `\d\d?` - one or two digits (hour)
- `:?` - optional colon
- `\d\d` - two digits (minutes)

So it supports formats like:
- +0530 (4 chars, no colon)
- +05:30 (with colon)
- +530 (3 chars, single digit hour)
- +5:30 (single digit hour with colon)
